title: Because You Showed Me the Way

text_block_list.text: Lately, Winning Ticket had been pouring her heart and soul into mock races.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
GOOOOOOOOAL!!
Winning Ticket takes firrrssst plaaaccceee!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Didja see my all-out, mega-massive victory?! 
I grabbed the glory, Trainer!!
There were days radiant with beaming smiles—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I... I lost... Me...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*sob*... *sniff*... WAAAAAAAHHH!!
It hurrrts so much!! Time to train from scratch!!
And there were days soaked—no, utterly drowned—in tears.

Through streaks of wins and strings of losses, the cycle continued.
And as for the results of today's mock race—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WAAAAAAAHHH!!
I loooossst againnn!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer!!
I gotta train harder and harder and waaay harder...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Allllright!! It's time for all-out, maximum, super training!!
First, laps around the academy—no, a lap around whole country of Japan...!!

Seeing Winning Ticket go wildly overboard as usual,
I hastily gave her a sensible training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Got it, thank you so much!!
Alright, off I go to run my laps!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Turning frustration into power! Next stop, the Derbaaaayyy!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—Hey there, good work.
Your trainee's every bit as energetic as the rumors say.
choice_data_list: She gives it everything she's got. I'm proud of her.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I can see that. But... judging by her mock race results,
it seems she still has some consistency issues.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Actually, rather than that... ah, I see.
She's simply wearing her heart on her sleeve.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply, her intense presence ends up firing up her rivals.
They think, 'Look at that speed! Damn it, I'm not gonna lose to her!'

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hiding your sharpest blade and catching opponents off-guard...
that, too, is a vital tactical skill on the turf, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oops, my bad. I shouldn't be talking so much to a rival Trainer.
Well, don't dwell on it too much. ...Take care.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...ner! Trainer!? Did your soul just leave your body...!?
Oh no, this is bad... TRAAAIINEEERRR!!

While pondering what was just said,
it seemed I had caused Winning Ticket some serious worry...
choice_data_list: Sorry, I was just lost in thought.
Sorry, I was just thinking about something.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoaa?! Trainer's back from the deaaad...!!
*sniff* Oh thank goodnessssss~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wait, lost in thought? About what, about what?!
Let me think through it with you! Like, hrnnngghh-grrrr-nnngghh!!
...She always gives her absolute all. I really want to help her win more.

To achieve that, should I teach Winning Ticket to feign weakness
and lower her opponents' guard, just as suggested?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hrrnngghh-grrrr-nnngghh...
What is it that's troubling my Trainer... WHAT IS ITTT...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
For my precious, most important partner...
What can I possibly do to heeelp...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hrrnngghh-grrrr-nnngghh-GAAAHH...!!

Watching her put everything she had into thinking—just as passionately as always—
it suddenly hit me.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Trainer?
Wait a second... you look kinda refreshed all of a sudden?
choice_data_list: Yeah, my doubts are gone now.
Yeah, I cleared up what was bothering me.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, really?! That's... that's awesome! Super duper awesome!
Hurrayyyyyy!!
choice_data_list: (It's best for you to just be yourself and give it your all!)
(It's best for you to just be yourself and give it your all!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's talk about our next training menu!
I'm gonna listen to everything you say with my whole heart!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer always watches over me! Always thinks about me!
That's why I—I believe in you!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
With you by my side, Trainer, without a single doubt!
I can keep running forward and forward with everything I've got!!

Seeing the boundless trust shining in her bright eyes once again...
I resolved to watch over her with even greater devotion.
